results.overview: A spy, an assassin and a telepath come together to pose as a family, each for their own reasons, while hiding their true identities from each other.
results.name: SPY x FAMILY

results.overview: The show is about the Bannon family, who all have strong spy links. The parents, Dirk and Talia, were once arch enemy spies, but fell in love and got married. They now have three children who have all been brought up with spy techniques as a matter of course.
results.name: My Spy Family

results.overview: In the late 1960s, a US Navy petty officer, with access to major state secrets and large debts, begins selling information to the Soviets.
results.name: Family of Spies
